_doc: Standing requests recorded from repository owners and contributors (issue-tracked). actions: "no-contact" = the outreach pipeline sends them nothing further; "no-include" = their code is not included in the hub. validate_hub.py fails any refresh whose candidates/authors ledger row or manifest matches a no-include entry (login as repo owner or contributor, or the repository itself), so an opt-out recorded in an issue cannot be silently reverted by a regeneration. Conversation stays in the referenced issue - no further email to anyone on this list.

entries.request: Do not use their code in the search engine; no further contact.
No outreach to agents; no content included under terms other than GPL-2.0 (none is).
No further outreach email; the fabricated MIT grant on their record was removed in 77e8b4305. Removal of the record itself happens on their word, in the issue.
